scope: Feature 42 independent local original SOFA-1 six-axis reviewed daily assessment and separate baseline/infection/attribution change review; complete source and result persistence, strict deterministic schema v9 gateway and worker, clinical UI and Super-admin governance. Manual reviewed originals and fixed local policies; not automatic sepsis diagnosis, continuous automatic warning, SOFA-2, clinical validation or all80 completion.

inventory.network_note: One urllib3 optional IPv6 loopback capability bind attempt was blocked before its syscall; socket closed. Successful network I/O zero. No database, dotenv, shared transport key, ASGI lifecycle or repository writes.

source_and_math_contract.daily_period: Exact complete 24h half-open UTC period and explicit historical availability cutoff, independently typed current Doctor review, all root membership and parents rechecked; necessary 1h vasoactive prefix retained.
source_and_math_contract.native_quantities: LIS signed decimal strings retained; other quantities follow their explicit nonnegative contracts. Closed native unit branches with original-unit SHA; no approximate native conversion, rounding, negative/qualitative-to-zero, NT=1, AVPU/GCS invention, RRT=4, default weight or NE equivalence.
source_and_math_contract.cardiovascular: Exact rational native doses and same-drug per-tier >=1h actual continuity; no cross-drug stitching or duplicate physical streams; proven non-overlap continuity retained outside conflicts. Explicit none exposure with known positive actual-day exposure rejected.
source_and_math_contract.partial_results: All candidates and source proofs, observed maxima, nullable known subtotal, unknown intervals, numeric collapse and protocol completeness remain independent; complete total only when all six axes and required coverage are complete.
source_and_math_contract.change_review: Independent full current/baseline recalculation; observed earlier daily source, explicit conditional-zero assumption or unknown baseline. Infection original and current acute/attribution/temporal review separate. Negative delta and exact [current_min-baseline_max,current_max-baseline_min] retained; unknown history never zero.
source_and_math_contract.outbound: Only typed public daily or change source and complete independently versioned system/task Prompts; private narratives, free question, direct patient/admission/author identities, barcode and external stream identity excluded. Technical source UUIDs remain explicit evidence references.
source_and_math_contract.binding_and_result_verification: Frozen Prompt, input, metadata, context, independent evidence and provider anchors; current authorization before queue/wire/acceptance; all math and fixed explanations recomputed; MEDIUMTEXT body and short reference accepted atomically with original lease/status/audit.

full_pytest.scope_note: Existing synthetic in-memory test DB overrides. This full regression does not claim every dotenv read is disabled; guarded SQL, container and inventory processes establish separate isolation.

full_browser.scope_note: Production and isolated UI use synthetic API interception; 21 original request cases use actual synthetic loopback HTTP. No hospital backend or remote model.

limitations: Synthetic originals and model responses only; no clinical validation or treatment actions.
Sequential CAS and actual failed SQL audit rollback, not simultaneous threaded contention.
Legacy naive clocks remain unknown provenance; no UTC or continuous-dose inference from those strings. Only explicitly timed governed originals enter the independent SOFA calculation.
